art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Headline with 'CURVAS' in fuchsia; 2) the happy woman with her curvy figure and the bottle in her hand; 3) the large bottle in the lower-right foreground; 4) the three benefit rows and the mini before/after card; 5) the gold band with the offer, 'Pagas al recibir' and the badge.
art_direction.composition_style: Layered asymmetric composition: text column on the left third, woman in the center-right middle ground, bottle in the right foreground, gold band anchoring the bottom left up to the bottle.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline 3-20% of the height on the left 3-62% of the width; value proposition 21-27%; benefit rows 29-55% separated by thin gold dividers; mini before/after card 57-80% on the left 3-34%; band 82-97% from 3% to 74% of the width; bottle 78-98% of the width and 38-96% of the height.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Warm golden practical light from the tree and string lights behind her (strong bokeh), a soft warm key light from the front-left on her face, a darker calm left third for the texts, crisp studio highlights on the foreground bottle sitting on a glossy surface.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Full-bleed warm Christmas living-room photo with heavy bokeh. Top left: two-line bold uppercase headline (line 1 white, line 2 white with the word 'CURVAS' in fuchsia) and one line of value proposition under it. Left column: three benefits with thin gold-ringed line-icon circles separated by thin gold dividers, and under them a small white-bordered card with two mini photos (before and after of the same woman on different days). Center-right: the woman standing three-quarters facing the camera, from head to knee, holding the bottle at chest height. Lower-right foreground: the bottle large. Bottom left: a wide rounded gold satin band with a ringed gift-box icon, a thin divider, the offer line and a white pill 'Pagas al recibir', and at its right end the round gold-bordered registration badge.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 warm Christmas lifestyle ad, full-bleed real photo. BACKGROUND: a cozy Colombian living room at night, a tall green Christmas tree on the right side behind her with warm Christmas gold #C9A54C string lights turned into big soft round bokeh, gifts wrapped in pine green #1F5C3A paper with gold ribbons at her feet, the left third of the frame darker and calm (a blurred dark wall with a few distant gold lights) so the texts read clearly. PERSON (center-right, from about 32% to 78% of the width, top of the head at about 9% of the height, cropped at the knees by the band and the bottom edge): an adult Afro-Colombian woman, 25 years old, deep dark skin with real visible pores and natural glow, long box braids half tied up, a wide genuine smile with teeth, looking straight at the camera; she stands three-quarters facing the camera, weight on one leg, one hand on her hip and the other hand holding the real bottle at chest height with the label facing the camera; she wears a pine green #1F5C3A turtleneck Christmas sweater tucked in and white high-waist skinny jeans; a curvy hourglass figure: small waist, hips clearly wider than her waist and rounded, toned thicker thighs filling the jeans, the change obvious at first glance but natural, never a back view. Camera: head-to-knee shot at chest height, 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field. TOP LEFT (3-20% of the height, 3-62% of the width): the headline in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase, left-aligned, two lines: line 1 'TU REGALO DE NAVIDAD:' in white #FFFFFF; line 2 'TUS CURVAS' with 'TUS' in white and the highlighted word 'CURVAS' in hot fuchsia #E6177F, larger. Under it (21-27%), one line in Poppins SemiBold, pale blush #FBE3EE: 'Caderas y piernas con más curva en tu tratamiento de 3 meses, para empezar el año segura de ti.' LEFT COLUMN (29-55% of the height, 3-34% of the width): three benefit rows separated by thin Christmas gold dividers; each row has a circle about 9% of the canvas with a thin gold #C9A54C ring and a white line icon (a curved hip silhouette, a leg with a small sparkle, a calendar), and white Poppins SemiBold text: 'Caderas con más curva', 'Piernas firmes que llenan tu jean', 'Tu plan de 3 meses, sin quirófano'. MINI BEFORE/AFTER CARD (57-80% of the height, 3-34% of the width): a white-bordered card with a slight shadow holding two small real photos side by side of the SAME woman on two DIFFERENT DAYS, with tiny white labels 'Antes' and 'Mes 3'. BEFORE photo: her bedroom in cool flat morning light, braids in a low bun, a grey hoodie and loose light-blue jeans one size too big; she stands side-on with her face to the camera and a frustrated look, her hand pulls the back waistband a full fist away from her lower back so the empty gap is clearly visible, baggy fold of denim below the seat, flat straight silhouette, thin straight thighs. AFTER photo: a sunny balcony in warm late-afternoon light, braids loose down her back, a camel knit top and dark-blue fitted jeans, three-quarter pose facing the camera, smiling, small waist, wider rounded hips and toned legs filling the jeans. PRODUCT (lower-right foreground, about 78-98% of the width and 38-96% of the height, about 55% of the canvas height, base near the bottom edge): the attached product, upright, front view, studio-sharp on a glossy dark surface with a soft gold reflection, slightly overlapping her leg. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth and do not redesign it: a matte black cylindrical bottle about 1.6 times taller than wide with straight sides, wide mouth and no neck, a glossy hot-pink screw cap almost as wide as the body (about 90%) and one fifth of its height with a small white 'VITALABH' pattern, a hot-pink band around the bottom fifth, black label with the pink VITALABH emblem, huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' and three boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA'; the bottle in her hand is the same bottle, smaller; not a slim bottle, not a squat jar; closed, never mirrored; matte, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare; no capsules anywhere. BOTTOM BAND (82-97% of the height, 3-74% of the width): a wide rounded rectangle in a satin Christmas gold #C9A54C gradient with a lighter thin border and a soft shadow; on its left a thin-ringed circle with a dark plum gift-box line icon, a thin vertical divider, then dark plum #2B1226 Poppins Bold text 'Tratamiento completo: 3 frascos para 3 meses' and, next to it, a white pill with plum Poppins Bold text 'Pagas al recibir'; at the right end of the band, overlapping its edge, a round badge with a solid gold #D4A437 border, plum center and white text 'REGISTRO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024'.
